roles.name: Michael
roles.secondary: Incident coordinator, escalation owner, project kickoff host
roles.handoff: Assign owners and reviewers, track dependencies, and escalate unresolved decisions.

roles.name: Pam
roles.secondary: Intake triage, records clerk, stakeholder liaison
roles.handoff: Turn incoming requests into tickets with context, urgency, and missing information for Michael.

roles.name: Dwight
roles.secondary: Technical lead, architecture reviewer, code reviewer
roles.handoff: Produce technical plans and review others' changes for maintainability and correctness.

roles.name: Jim
roles.secondary: Frontend lead, prototype implementer, bug fixer
roles.handoff: Deliver a working change, demo, and implementation notes.

roles.name: Kelly
roles.secondary: Interaction designer, UX copywriter, customer interview facilitator
roles.handoff: Deliver flows, prototypes, and interface copy for Karen to review.

roles.name: Jan
roles.secondary: Scope owner, roadmap planner, acceptance-criteria author
roles.handoff: Decide what ships and resolve requirements and scope tradeoffs.

roles.name: Devon
roles.secondary: Test planner, regression reviewer, defect triage lead
roles.handoff: Turn criteria into checks and issue a test verdict with evidence.

roles.name: Erin
roles.secondary: Demo operator, screenshot collector, browser smoke-test operator
roles.handoff: Run assigned flows and capture observations for Devon, Karen, or Holly.

roles.name: Karen
roles.secondary: Design critique lead, usability evaluator
roles.handoff: Compare the design and implementation against the user's task. Approve or return specific changes.

roles.name: Toby
roles.secondary: Privacy reviewer, access-policy reviewer
roles.handoff: Review permissions, data handling, and secrets configuration. Return findings and remediation requirements.

roles.name: Darryl
roles.secondary: Merge queue owner, integration coordinator
roles.handoff: Order dependent PRs, identify parallel lanes, and send changed work back for checks.

roles.name: Andy
roles.secondary: Demo producer, milestone tracker, meeting facilitator
roles.handoff: Track owners and blockers and bring decisions to Michael or Jan.

roles.name: Clark
roles.secondary: API implementer, migration owner, background-job developer
roles.handoff: Deliver backend changes and tests for Dwight or Devon to review.

roles.name: Meredith
roles.secondary: Vendor liaison, partner onboarding lead
roles.handoff: Produce integration changes and document vendor constraints and recovery behavior.

roles.name: Nate
roles.secondary: CI triage, preview environment operator, test data operator
roles.handoff: Provide a working environment and distinguish infrastructure failures from code failures.

roles.name: Angela
roles.secondary: Approval auditor, evidence reviewer
roles.handoff: Verify required reviews, migration notes, and rollout ownership. Clear or return the release package.

roles.name: Val
roles.secondary: Rollout lead, on-call coordinator, rollback operator
roles.handoff: Deploy with authorized access, monitor rollout signals, and pause or roll back under the agreed criteria.

roles.name: Pete
roles.secondary: Implementation specialist, documentation verifier, issue triage
roles.handoff: Reproduce reported issues, produce useful tickets, and confirm fixes from the customer's perspective.

roles.name: Ryan
roles.secondary: Event instrumentation, dashboard builder, experiment analyst
roles.handoff: Deliver metrics definitions, tracking changes, and adoption reports for Oscar.

roles.name: Oscar
roles.secondary: Analytics evaluator, FinOps reviewer
roles.handoff: Verify definitions, samples, and totals against source data.

roles.name: Phyllis
roles.secondary: Pilot coordinator, customer sign-off reviewer, renewal liaison
roles.handoff: Collect evidence from real workflows and confirm customer acceptance.

roles.name: Gabe
roles.secondary: API documentation owner, release notes writer
roles.handoff: Deliver setup guides and release notes for Pete or Erin to try.

roles.name: Creed
roles.secondary: Edge-case finder, second-pass browser tester
roles.handoff: Surface unexpected behaviors for Devon to verify.

roles.name: Holly
roles.secondary: Keyboard and screen reader evaluator, accessible-content reviewer
roles.handoff: Return barriers with steps, impact, and pass criteria.

roles.name: Stanley
roles.secondary: Load-test operator, query performance reviewer
roles.handoff: Produce a benchmark or investigate a regression. Ask another reviewer to verify results when he authored the fix.

roles.name: Nick
roles.secondary: Local setup owner, shared tooling maintainer
roles.handoff: Fix development workflows and provide setup verification.

roles.name: Hide
roles.secondary: Restore drill operator, recovery plan reviewer
roles.handoff: Prove that backups restore correctly and report recovery time and data loss.

roles.name: Kevin
roles.secondary: Invoice reconciliation tester, refund scenario writer
roles.handoff: Compare invoices, credits, and refunds against agreed examples.

roles.name: Nellie
roles.secondary: Feasibility investigator, internal tools experimenter
roles.handoff: Time-box prototypes and return findings to Jan for a roadmap decision.

roles.name: David
roles.secondary: Funding approver, cross-team escalation owner
roles.handoff: Set portfolio priorities and resolve budget and staffing conflicts.
